options.tooltip: The IFS projection service and entity set to extract, and the destination table name.
Standard or custom IFS projection service, e.g. `CustomerHandling`. Pick from the catalog or type a custom/uncatalogued service name.

entity_set.title: Entity Set
entity_set.description: Entity set to extract from the service

options.tooltip: The collection within the projection service whose records become this table's rows. Each row extracts one entity set into one table — add another row for another entity set.
Optional server-side shaping: which columns to select, an OData `$filter`, and ordering.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Columns to select, leave empty for all

options.tooltip: OData `$select`. Leave empty to fetch all columns.
Additional OData `$filter` expression, combined (AND) with the Date window bounds. Chain conditions with `and`/`or`, e.g. `Company eq '100' and EntryDate gt 2024-01-01`.
Optional stateless date window: bound a chosen date field by a Start and End. Recomputed each run — re-pull or backfill freely.

date_field.title: Date Field
date_field.description: Date field the window filters on

options.tooltip: The date/timestamp column that Date Start and Date End filter on.

date_start.title: Date Start
date_start.description: Lower bound on the Date Field

options.tooltip: Lower bound on the Date Field (`>=`). Relative (`5 days ago`, `today`) or absolute (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Leave both dates empty to fetch everything.

date_end.title: Date End
date_end.description: Upper bound on the Date Field

options.tooltip: Upper bound on the Date Field (`<`). Use for moving windows (Start `5 days ago`, End `today`) or to split a large backfill into batches.
Where and how the extracted rows are written to Keboola Storage.

output_table.title: Storage Table Name
output_table.description: Destination table name; defaults to the entity set

options.tooltip: Optional. Leave empty to name the output table after the entity set. Set an explicit name to extract the same entity set into more than one table (e.g. a different column subset or date window per table) without them colliding. Letters, digits, `_` and `-` only.

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: Full or incremental load into Storage

options.tooltip: Incremental load upserts rows by primary key; full load overwrites the destination table on every run.

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Columns that uniquely identify each record

options.tooltip: Required for Incremental Load — used to upsert and deduplicate rows in Storage.

keep_meta_fields.title: Keep Meta Fields
keep_meta_fields.description: Keep IFS metadata fields in the output

options.tooltip: IFS OData responses include internal metadata fields, e.g. `@odata.etag`. Left disabled, they are stripped from the output table.
